description: A process lives in a table: one row per case, one column per step. Flow Chart turns those columns into the diagram people actually argue about — where the volume goes, where it comes back, and where it stops. Drag one field per level, in order, plus a measure. That is the whole setup. The visual builds the nodes, links them, orders each layer so the lines cross as little as possible, and sizes every link by its value. THE DIAGRAM • One field per hierarchy level, in the order you drag them — the field names do not matter • Link width by value, so the main route is visible before anyone reads a number • A node can have more than one parent: two channels feeding the same step draw correctly • Rework loops back to an earlier level are drawn as dashed returns, not hidden • Horizontal or vertical, with node and layer spacing under your control • Colour by level or a single colour, with a legend • Zoom, fit and a minimap for diagrams that outgrow the canvas INTEGRATED WITH POWER BI • Click a node or a link to cross-filter the report; the rest of the page follows • Filters from other visuals are reflected in the diagram • Tooltips on nodes and links, with the value and its share of the total • Keyboard navigation, screen reader labels and high contrast PRO • Collapse and expand branches — the first thing you reach for past thirty nodes • Node search, to find one step in a diagram you…
